title: Transit Systems
scope: This ledger ranks U.S. transit agencies on FTA NTD unlinked passenger trips for the latest published month, including every Massachusetts reporter, and also reports NTD report-year 2024 agency operating expenses and farebox recovery. Mode-by-mode MBTA reliability stays on DL-03.
exclusions: Does not cover MBTA mode-by-mode reliability or The RIDE (those stay on DL-03), capital budgets, or fare advice.
heritage: Formerly Compare Systems and MassTransit Comparing Systems
vintage_note: Rebuilt Aug 15, 2026 from FTA NTD Complete Monthly Ridership (Socrata 8bui-9xvu). Headline is unlinked passenger trips summed by agency for June 2026. U.S. total equals 690,656,393. Mode-by-mode MBTA reliability and cost stay on DL-03. Later views compiled Aug 15, 2026 are stored under derived.secondary.

SRC-622-01.name: FTA NTD complete monthly ridership by agency
SRC-622-01.supports: This ledger ranks U.S. transit agencies on FTA NTD unlinked passenger trips for the latest published month, including every Massachusetts reporter, and also reports NTD report-year 2024 agency operating expenses and farebox recovery. Mode-by-mode MBTA reliability stays on DL-03.

SRC-622-02.name: FTA NTD annual agency operating expenses and fare revenues, report year 2024
SRC-622-02.supports: This ledger ranks U.S. transit agencies on FTA NTD unlinked passenger trips for the latest published month, including every Massachusetts reporter, and also reports NTD report-year 2024 agency operating expenses and farebox recovery. Mode-by-mode MBTA reliability stays on DL-03.

q: Compare U.S. transit agencies on ridership, cost, and recovery. Not the MBTA-only page.
metric_label: Unlinked passenger trips by transit agency, June 2026
lead: U.S. transit agencies reported 690,656,393 unlinked passenger trips in June 2026 (SRC-622-01). The MBTA reported 26,288,869, rank 5 of 518 agencies (derived, SRC-622-01). MTA New York City Transit was the largest agency (SRC-622-01). In NTD report year 2024, U.S. agencies reported $65.62 billion in operating expenses, with a 17.2% farebox recovery rate (derived, SRC-622-02). The MBTA spent $2.16 billion, recovered 19.2% from fares, and cost $8.59 per unlinked trip (derived, SRC-622-02).

kpis.label: MBTA
kpis.detail: Rank 5 of 518 U.S. agencies (derived, SRC-622-01). Massachusetts agencies together reported 29,503,796 trips.
kpis.why: The MBTA is the Massachusetts comparison; mode-level views stay on DL-03.

kpis.label: Largest U.S. agency
kpis.why: Agency-level comparison is the former Compare Systems view.
